gold: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) with polyradiculopathy

selector.rationale: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis), severe flaccid quadriparesis, and cerebrospinal fluid analysis showing 98% atypical cells/blasts strongly support leukemia as the champion diagnosis.

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: While neurolymphomatosis could explain some symptoms, the presence of leukemia cutis and specific CSF findings favor leukemia.

rejected.label: Cauda equina syndrome
rejected.why: Cauda equina syndrome is a symptom complex that can result from various conditions, including leukemia, but the broader range of symptoms and specific findings point more directly to leukemia.
